admission.justification: Future changes to host intake, task projection or task-status consumers must preserve this bounded authority: duplicate task truth, unsupported paused observations, reconstructed membership or conflicting status/age presentation produce incorrect task operations. The named current source assertions guard the specified facets; this is no fresh Curator execution grade. The D305 Order accent is a finite presentation exception, not conflicting native status or a second activity owner.

applicability: Canonical task-status words and marks across dashboard task surfaces, with the finite Order-drawing started-accent exception.
conditions: The shared presentation still formats native task words and marks; the limited word is one more row in the one table, with paused's tone.
The time left uses the existing compact unit from the display clock to the reset, and never counts below zero.
A place without a display clock shows the bare limited word and puts the reset in its hover and accessible name.
`TaskStatusWord` derives displayed age from the served event time and its display clock, and a missing clock invents no epoch.
exclusions: Operational severity dots, process phases, dependency-readiness badges and review/landing verdict vocabulary are distinct domains.
No second served elapsed age and no browser-derived lifecycle truth.
The Order-drawing started accent remains the one explicit exception and replaces no shared palette.
